The cleanest direct public-market exposure among US-listed names is still concentrated in coatings leaders, especially PPG and Sherwin-Williams, but those are broad, well-followed companies where marine antifouling is only a segment. The underfollowed lane is thinner: RPM/Carboline offers a less obvious protective/marine coatings adjacency, while Coda Octopus is a micro-cap speculative exception tied to underwater inspection rather than coatings or cleaning. No candidate here should be treated as a proven shipping-disruption beneficiary until order acceleration, fleet adoption, or segment-level revenue sensitivity is verified.
